# TheSportsMag

> > TheSportsMag provides sports news, beginner guides, and fantasy sports platform reviews covering cricket, tennis, squash, and other sports.

TheSportsMag is operated by Red Hat Media and covers major sporting events like IPL, EPL, and provides comprehensive beginner guides for various sports. The site also reviews fantasy sports platforms popular in India including Dream11, MyTeam11, and BatBall11.

## Key Topics

- IPL (Indian Premier League)
- Fantasy Cricket
- BCCI
- Dream11
- MyTeam11
- Beginner Sports Guides
- Tennis
- Squash
- Throwball
- Sports Equipment
- Fantasy Sports Platforms
- Cricket News
- Sports Updates
- India Sports

## Getting Started

- [TheSportsMag: Latest Sports News, Updates, and Guides](https://thesportsmag.org): Homepage featuring IPL, golf, basketball, EPL and football derbies
- [TheSportsMag: Latest Sports News, Updates, and Guides](https://thesportsmag.org/the-sports-mag): Main landing page for TheSportsMag with newsletter signup

## Beginner Sports Guides

- [A Beginner's Guide To Throw Ball](https://thesportsmag.org/throw-ball): Throwball beginner guide covering history, rules from England to India
- [How To Play Tennis? A Step By Step Guide For Beginners In 2021](https://thesportsmag.org/how-to-play-tennis): Beginner tennis guide covering racquet selection and grip techniques
- [A Beginner's Guide To Squash Game - TheSportsMag](https://thesportsmag.org/squash-game): Squash beginner guide covering history, rules and 2028 Olympics inclusion
- [Escape From Tarkov: Improving Accuracy And Recoil Control](https://thesportsmag.org/improving-accuracy-and-recoil-control): Escape from Tarkov FPS guide for accuracy and recoil control tips

## Fantasy Sports Platform Reviews

- [Dream11 Review: Know All About Dream11 Game](https://thesportsmag.org/dream11-review): Dream11 fantasy sports review covering IPL and unicorn club status
- [MyTeam11 Review- How To Play MyTeam11, Is MyTeam11 Safe?](https://thesportsmag.org/myteam11-review): MyTeam11 fantasy cricket platform review with Virender Sehwag endorsement
- [GoSuper11 Review- How To Play GoSuper11, Is GoSuper11 Safe](https://thesportsmag.org/gosuper11-review): GoSuper11 fantasy sports platform review for T20 World Cup 2022
- [BatBall11 Review- How To Play BatBall11, Is BatBall11 Safe?](https://thesportsmag.org/batball11-review): BatBall11 fantasy cricket review with Ranji Trophy coverage details
